metadata.description: A status line, a side pane and a top-bar goal pin for the Claude Code terminal.

plugins.name: project-dashboard
plugins.description: Side pane: this session's dev servers (click to open), repo docs (click to open), and a PBI board summary for backlog-delivery repos.

plugins.name: goal-pin
plugins.description: Top bar: pins the current goal above the prompt. /goal <text>, or the first prompt of the session.
